title: Cambridge IELTS 19 — Test 3
description: Đề lẻ, chỉ có Reading và Listening — không có Writing và Speaking nên không thi thử full được. Chọn một trong hai kỹ năng để làm. Cả hai đều chấm ngay theo đáp án và ra band luôn. Phần Listening dùng một file ghi âm liền cho cả bốn phần.

questions.prompt: Which TWO reasons does the speaker give for recommending Alive and Kicking?

options.text: It will appeal to both boys and girls.
The author is well known.
It has colourful illustrations.
It is funny.
It deals with an important topic.

questions.prompt: How does Clare feel about the students in her Year 12 science class?

options.text: worried that they are not making progress
challenged by their poor behaviour in class
frustrated at their lack of interest in the subject

questions.prompt: What problem do they agree may be involved in an experiment involving animals?

options.text: Any results may not apply to humans.
It may be complicated to get permission.
Students may not be happy about animal experiments.

questions.prompt: What question do they decide the experiment should address?

options.text: Are mice capable of controlling their food intake?
Does an increase in sugar lead to health problems?
How much do supplements of different kinds affect health?

questions.prompt: Clare might also consider doing another experiment involving

options.text: other types of food supplement.
different genetic strains of mice.
varying amounts of exercise.
